description: This source file defines a set of regular expressions for identifying specific file types and naming conventions, and provides utility functions for normalizing file paths and classifying files within a codebase, particularly distinguishing source files from test, infrastructure, and API barrel files.

methods.name: normalizeExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Replaces all backslashes in a file path with forward slashes to normalize the path format.

methods.name: classifyBundledExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Classifies a given file path into categories such as code file, API barrel, test-like, infrastructure artifact, and production source, based on regex tests.
